blocks.text: Goal (optional): raise the pentacle to tier 2 so it can cure matrix effects ([[corruption/matrix]]).

On top of the whole tier 1 structure: two Void Stones stacked on each of the four outer corners (any color), with a Void Crystal Pillar standing on each stack; Demonic Crystal Pillars count too. Not a single block of tier 1 may be missing.
When it is complete the rune turns purple. Tier 2 draws from 16 pillars, 57600 ESPE when all are full, which covers 11 of the 14 matrix effects.

blocks.title: Beyond tier 2
blocks.text: {lang:corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix_12}, {lang:corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix_19} and {lang:corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix_20} cost 72000 each; a full tier 2 is not enough, you need tier 3 ([[pentacle/tier_three]]).

title: Tier 3 Pentacle
summary: Every ESPE counts double; cures everything

blocks.text: Goal (optional): raise the pentacle to tier 3, the highest. It can cure every corruption effect, and each point of ESPE in the pillars counts as two.

Prepare: 4 {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_plating} (see [[demons/demonic_plating]]) and 4 {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_crystal_pillar}s. A Demonic Crystal Pillar takes 6 {item:essentialcraft5:ackronite_ingot}s and 2 {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_core}s around a Void Crystal Pillar, which is used up (Ackronite: see [[demons/ackronite]]).

On top of the whole tier 2 structure: on the layer below the pentacle, one Demonic Plating two blocks away due east, south, west and north (any color); in the same four directions, 3 blocks higher than the pentacle, a Demonic Crystal Pillar each.

blocks.title: Floating pillars
blocks.text: Nothing is under a demonic pillar's base, so you cannot place it directly: put a few blocks underneath, place the pillar, then break them away.

When it is complete the rune turns red. Tier 3 draws from 20 pillars and counts every point twice, 144000 ESPE when all are full: it cures even the three 72000 matrix effects, taking only 100000 from the pillars for one.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You open a tier 3 pentacle and get the advancement "Soul Cleansing".
